packages.name: Gamma as a chart family
packages.hypothesis: A saturation kernel f(x)=x/(1+x) applied to x (Gamma_C), x^2 (Gamma_A) and weighted x*f(x^2) (Gamma_B) — up to the scale k=beta*rho_crit/a0.
packages.verified_fact: In the code: Gamma_A=f(u), Gamma_C=f(sqrt u), Gamma_B=sqrt(u)*f(u), u=rho/rho_crit.
packages.open_seam: Is sqrt(u)=x? I.e. is k=1, or are they separated by the dimension-carrying scale 4*pi*G_N*rho_crit/(3*a0)?
packages.structural_finding: Gamma_A and Gamma_C saturate toward 1; Gamma_B diverges as sqrt(u). The divergence character is not preserved under coordinate change -> B is not a reparametrization of A/C.
packages.falsifier: k != 1, sign/unit/normalization incompatible, or a different regime.
packages.sign_check: KC1 excludes the sqrt(g) form — a sqrt hit is NOT a victory signature.
packages.next_artifact: typed Gamma map (source, variable, unit, regime, observable) — not a decision.

packages.name: a0 as chart convergence (inherited, not a finding)
packages.hypothesis: a0_eff ~ cH0 is a Verlinde/Milgrom coincidence that EFC INHERITS; the EFC-specific part is C^2 ~ 5.4 as a discrete renormalization.
packages.open_seam: (a) C=2.32 is an INDEPENDENTLY derived topological constant (Watson integral / cubic lattice Green function), or (b) C^2=cH0/a0 BY CONSTRUCTION because L_Lambda ~ c/H0 is input to the lattice -> tautology.
packages.falsifier: common origin via declared a0 ~ c^2*sqrt(Lambda) input; a closed form for C is missing.
packages.next_artifact: closed derivation of C=2.32 from cubic topology, OR re-declaration of a0_eff as a fit.

packages.name: Lattice -> macro seams
packages.hypothesis: grid-action, effective response, relativistic field equation (box phi=Gamma(rho)), galactic RAR are projections of one operator.
packages.open_seam: Where does the chain change object? Is Gamma in box phi=Gamma(rho) the SAME object as dS/drho or the grid-action Gamma (sign/unit/normalization)? Does the grid-action sqrt(g) exponent survive as the same object?
packages.falsifier: missing variational derivation, different Gamma, dimensional/sign breach.
packages.next_artifact: seam map with typed transitions per link.

packages.name: Regime/phase
packages.hypothesis: Gamma_A/B/C are OVERLAPPING competing forms of the same Gamma(rho) target (source-supported), NOT disjoint phases. Model selection is unexecuted (delta_chi2=null everywhere).
packages.structural_support: B unbounded (sqrt u), A/C saturate toward 1 -> B is a DIFFERENT FUNCTION, but that is NOT evidence of a separate phase; the sources assign no u->S mapping. Phase-reading downgraded to a lower-support hypothesis.
packages.falsifier: all three claimed for the same regime + same observable without a selection rule.
packages.next_artifact: explicit domain information from the sources.

packages.name: Paradigm projection
packages.hypothesis: MOND/LCDM/EFC use partly different coordinates and proxies on overlapping data — interpretation difference, not mutually exclusive truths.
packages.open_seam: RECOVERED_BY_LIMIT_OF is an atlas declaration, not an empirically confirmed recovery; it requires the same observable + nuisance + likelihood.
packages.falsifier: out-of-sample observable with the same likelihood and locked nuisance parameters.
